description: WPE web wallpaper pages and the scene host: the file: iframes of WpeWallpaperContent / WpeSceneView in the main window (gallery preview, app background) and in the wallpaper windows (desktop). Answer pings, listen to wallpaper-ping and wpe-scene-clear-storage, subscribe to audio / media data over a channel, attach itself to native mouse injection (tauri-plugin-cursor). Properties are pushed by the parent page (wpe_web_get_state is app-page only), so the iframe cannot read state or app events. Only subframes match: both windows' main frames are app pages, covered by the ACL exemption
